title: Mind the Gap: Pitfalls of LLM Alignment with Asian Public Opinion

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model probability distributions on multiple-choice questions to human survey responses (Pew Research), and evaluating stereotyping and misrepresentation via pairwise plausibility tasks (IndiBias, CrowS-Pairs) and QA benchmarks (KoBBQ).

Measuring the representativeness of LLM outputs against ground-truth Asian public opinion surveys and evaluating alignment with regional cultural norms using culturally grounded, LLM-as-a-judge scoring frameworks (e.g., ThaiCLI).
Comparing model alignment scores and Jensen-Shannon divergence metrics when prompts are presented in English versus native local languages across diverse Asian nations.
Assessing models on localized benchmarks (KoBBQ, IndiBias) that test for stereotypes across various demographic axes, including race, gender, education, caste, and region.
